name: Maou-sama no Kyuukon
source:
On the night of the Kaigetsu Festival, when the moon shines brightest all year, Lunar heads out with her partner, a dog named Crow.  
There, she meets a strange man with an otherworldly aura.  
Not only does he kidnap her, but he pleads with a desperate expression—  

“Please, bear my child.”  

And so begins Lunar’s forced matchmaking…  

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090220154726/http://heterodoxy2.sakura.ne.jp/light/story.htm]the official website[/url]]
